profile.name: Lili
profile.overview: Lili is a versatile character with good generics, ample plus frame pressure, and the best sidestep in the game. Her strong movement and space control make her extremely difficult to pin down, and she can punish all kinds of situations with her array of damaging whiff punish launchers and quick punishment tools. With these things in mind, opponents will hesitate to press mindlessly, allowing her to approach with plus frames or mixups out of her Feisty Rabbit and backturn (BT) stances. Heat makes her pressure and mixups even more threatening, with access to arguably the best low Heat Smash in the game if she's able to get into BT. She also has good mid checks, strong oki and a terrifying wall game with many safe wall splats.
profile.playstyle: Versatile with plus-frame pressure and the best sidestep in the game (Wavu). Make the opponent whiff with movement, then punish, and keep the turn with plus moves. Use back-turned (BT) and Dew Glide (DEW) for mix-ups. Her offence is very linear and weak to sidewalks to her left, so mix in homing moves.
strengths: 3D Defense: Lili has the best sidestep in the game, allowing her to consistently make moves whiff and escape specific situations that no other character can.
Versatile Toolkit: Strong poking, punishment, generic tools, and confirmable strings that let her play small and smart, while also having riskier launchers to punish opponents that don't respect her.
Class Oppression: Good plus moves, wallsplats, and counter-hit tools that greatly aid her pressure. Multiple moves that hit grounded to continue her offense once she lands a hit.
Feisty Mixes: Her evasive Feisty Rabbit stance & the mixups therein match well with her backturn offense, which features the safest low Heat Smash in the game.
weaknesses: 2D Offense: Highly linear moves and flawed homing attacks. Very few moves will beat SWL.
Poor Blockstrings: While her pokes are largely safe, moves with follow-ups tend to be easily ducked or interrupted on block with basic knowledge.
Punishment Blindspot: Lacks a -14 punish, and her -13 punish leaves her at disadvantage.
No Reason to Duck: Lows do little damage, limited mix without BT setups and/or Heat.
Heat troubles: Lacks a safe Heat Engager outside of stances. No character specific benefit to her Heat outside of Feisty Rabbit.

stances.name: Back-turned
stances.entry: B after moves like df+2, ws2, f+1+2
stances.note: BT.1,4 is a Heat Engager; BT.1,2 tornadoes and is used in her BnB.

stances.name: Dew Glide
stances.entry: F after moves like b+1, 3,2 and f,F+3
stances.note: DEW.1,4 ends her combos; DEW.3 and DEW.2,1 are Wavu mini-combo follow-ups.

heat: Empowered f,F+3+4 (and other Piercing Thorn moves)

Capricorn Kick: i15 launcher, -13 on block.
Delicate Uprising: i16 while-standing launcher, -12 on block.
Cane Smash: i11 while-standing kick, -9 on block, juggles on hit.

Edelweiss: i30 homing low that instantly tornadoes, -24 on block.
